lines.en: label rinsummer2cafegen:
scene rinsummer2cafegen
I head over to the cafe to drink a random combination of syrups and espresso and hang out with a girl who would rather sleep with {i}another{/i} girl than me.
lines.zh: 我去咖啡馆把糖浆和浓缩咖啡随便兑在一起喝，顺便陪一个宁愿跟{i}别的{/i}女孩上床也不愿跟我上床的女孩。

lines.en: Why I have decided to be so unabashedly confrontational about that via inner monologue, I don’t know. Especially since I, too, would rather sleep with a girl than myself.
lines.zh: 我为什么要在内心独白里这么毫不掩饰地针锋相对，我自己也不知道。尤其是我自己也宁愿跟女孩上床，而不是跟自己。

lines.en: But I digress.
The morning proceeds normally and Rin fills me in on all of the latest happenings of her life that I may have missed over the last 24 hours.
lines.zh: 上午照常过去，Rin 把她过去二十四小时里我可能错过的近况统统补给我。

lines.en: As you may have guessed, all of them involve either Otoha or music. Or both of those things.
lines.zh: 你大概猜得到，全都跟 Otoha 或者音乐有关。或者两者都有。

lines.en: And while I’m happy that she’s getting to dive face first into the things she loves as of late, I can’t help but wish there was some piece of me in there.
lines.zh: 虽然我很高兴她最近能一头扎进自己热爱的事物里，可我还是忍不住希望其中有我的一席之地。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == True:
I understand why there’s not, though.
lines.zh: 不过我明白为什么没有。

lines.en: And at this point, I honestly doubt there ever will be.
lines.zh: 而且事到如今，我真怀疑以后也不会有。

lines.en: else:
It doesn’t have to be a big piece. Even a sliver would be fine.
lines.zh: 也不需要多大的位置。哪怕只是一小片也行。

lines.en: I just feel like we’re moving backwards all of a sudden.
lines.zh: 我只是突然觉得我们在倒退。

lines.en: And the idea of that hits me harder than it should.
lines.zh: 而这个念头对我的打击，比它本该有的还要重。

lines.en: scene black
A flood of customers all decide to caffeinate at the same time and I seize the opportunity to bail out before I get wrapped up in the mess.
lines.zh: 一大群客人不约而同地决定在同一时间来补充咖啡因，我趁乱开溜，免得被卷进这团混乱里。

lines.en: Rin notices me leaving and stops what she’s doing to say goodbye, causing the customer she’s currently helping to get pissed off-
lines.zh: Rin 注意到我要走，停下手里的事跟我道别，害得她正在接待的那位顾客很生气——

lines.en: But allowing {i}me{/i} to leave the building knowing I haven’t been completely forgotten yet.
lines.zh: 但也让{i}我{/i}走出店门时知道自己还没有被彻底遗忘。

lines.en: And that the thought of me may just cross her mind while her tongue is in her girlfriend’s mouth.
lines.zh: 也知道当她的舌头伸进她女朋友嘴里的时候，说不定会闪过我的念头。

lines.en: $ rin_love += 1
{i}Rin’s affection has increased to [rin_love]!{/i}
jump saturdayafternoon
